name: n8n Instance Health & Cost Monitor v2 – Incident Triage, Trend Anomalies & Error Clustering

parameters.content:
## 🩺 n8n Instance Health & Cost Monitor

For anyone running a self-hosted or cloud n8n instance with dozens of active workflows, where a broken credential or a looping AI agent can fail hundreds of times or burn through an OpenAI budget overnight before anyone looks.

### How it works
Every hour, the workflow reads recent executions for every active workflow through the n8n API, then works out error rates, run volume and estimated LLM spend. Runaway workflows are switched off automatically (tag one `no-auto-disable` to protect it), and every incident is posted to Slack with the failing node and error message. Repeat warnings are held back by a cooldown.

Every Monday it looks at the whole week instead. It compares it with the week before, groups similar errors into clusters, and has GPT-4o-mini write a short health report. That report is emailed with a Slack TL;DR, and the week's numbers are saved so the trend builds up over time.

### Setup steps
1. Create an n8n API key (Settings → n8n API) and add it as Header Auth with the `X-N8N-API-KEY` header.
2. Create a Google Sheet with **Guard_Log** and **Metrics_History** tabs.
3. Connect Google Sheets, Slack, Gmail and OpenAI.
4. In **Set Monitor Config**, set your instance URL, thresholds, token budget and digest email.
5. Run the hourly guard once manually, then activate.

## ⏰ Schedules & Config
Two modes share one pipeline: an hourly guard that looks at the last hour, and a Monday digest that looks at the last seven days. Thresholds, token budget and alert cooldown are set once in the config node.

## 📊 Collect Metrics
Lists active workflows through the n8n API (skipping this one), pulls recent executions for each, and works out runs, failures, error rate, p95 duration and estimated LLM cost for AI workflows.

## 🔍 Incident Triage
Sorts each workflow into critical, warning or fine. Repeat warnings are held back for the cooldown. For anything flagged, it fetches the latest failed run to pull out the failing node and error message.

## 📈 Trends & Error Clusters
Compares this week with last week's snapshot and samples recent failures, grouping similar error messages so you see the three root causes behind fifty red executions.

## 🛑 Auto-Disable & Alert
Critical workflows are deactivated before they burn more credits, unless tagged `no-auto-disable` or `critical`, which only get an alert. Every incident goes to Slack with the error context and is logged.

## 🧠 AI Digest & History
GPT-4o-mini turns the numbers into a short health report with a score and priorities. It's emailed, a TL;DR goes to Slack, and this week's metrics are saved for next week's comparison.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
The n8n API key can read and deactivate every workflow, so store it as a credential and share this workflow carefully. Execution data can include customer payloads, so keep the Guard Log sheet private.

values.content:
You are an SRE reviewing a self-hosted n8n instance. Use only the numbers provided. Return ONLY JSON:
{
 "headline": "one sentence on overall health and the week-over-week direction",
 "health_score": 0-100,
 "key_findings": ["max 4 bullets, cite workflow names and numbers"],
 "root_causes": ["max 3: interpret the error clusters – e.g. one credential expiring across several workflows, a rate-limited API, a broken expression – and name the fix"],
 "anomaly_actions": ["max 3 actions for the high/medium anomalies, incl. silent workflows"],
 "cost_actions": ["max 3 concrete savings, e.g. move to gpt-4o-mini, cache results, trim prompts, batch calls"]
}
